unlisted_practices: The European Commission should ensure there is no pause between passing the AI Act and building the governance structures needed to implement it.
EU AI Act governance bodies should demonstrate intelligence, flexibility, and rapid responsiveness to emergent problems in implementing the Act.
EU bodies should clarify ambiguities in the AI Act and its intersection with the MDR and IVDR through standards, guidelines, and implementing laws.
